title: NeuroFlow Extension: bids/profile
description: Reference schema for the bids/profile extension namespace. Describes BIDS-aware tool roles, the BIDS-required-fields knowledge base each detector and fixer relies on, refacing/defacing metadata, and the subject relabeling shape. This is an extension contract, not part of the portable NeuroFlow core, but it pairs with the core fix-proposal pattern defined in §21.

role.description: Tool's role in a BIDS-aware workflow. Determines which fix-proposal categories the tool produces or consumes.

modality.description: BIDS modalities this tool can handle. Drawn from the BIDS Common Principles datatype list.

requiredFields.description: Per-suffix list of JSON sidecar fields the tool treats as required. Keys are BIDS suffixes (e.g. bold, T1w, dwi, magnitude1). Values are arrays of field names. A bids:fix-proposal emitted by this tool MAY reference these field names.

recommendedFields.description: Per-suffix list of recommended-but-not-required sidecar fields. Missing recommended fields raise warn-severity proposals.

fillFrom.description: Provenance sources a fixer may consult to populate missing fields. Keys are BIDS field names; values describe where to look for the value.

dicomTag.description: DICOM tag in (group,element) hex form, e.g. (0018,0080).

refacing.description: Refacing / defacing metadata for tools that detect or perform either transformation.

detect.description: Tool detects whether an anat image has been defaced.

annotationField.description: Sidecar field set by this tool to record the transformation. Conventional: DefacedBy / RefacedBy.

subjectPolicy.description: Subject identifier policy for relabel detectors and fixers.

pattern.description: Regex that valid sub-<id> values must satisfy after relabeling, e.g. ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$.

rules.description: Ordered rename rules. Each entry replaces match groups in scanner-side ids with the target form.

match.description: Regex applied to the scanner-side identifier.

replace.description: Replacement string, may include capture group refs.

outputDataset.description: Configuration for writer tools that emit a BIDS or BIDS-Derivatives dataset.

pipelineName.description: Value to use for GeneratedBy[].Name in dataset_description.json when emitting derivatives.
